params.body:
Mollie refused gentells.com while the "Coming soon" cover was up. To be reviewed, the site goes public with the Mollie **test** key, and the whole paid flow has to work and be safe in test mode. Trendwolves also invoices through Mollie Invoicing, so the site now makes the invoice for every payment.

## Test mode, made safe to show

- **Mode on everything.** Buyers (`users.billing_mode`) and payment rows (`payments.mollie_mode`) carry Mollie's mode. Mollie keeps customers, mandates and subscriptions apart per mode.
- **The switch to live.** A plan a test payment opened reads as Explore the moment the key is live (`User::plan`), `billing:settle` clears its billing ids (`test-ended`), and `billing:check` fails while any are left. A test-era buyer who checks out again gets a new live customer. Going back to a test key leaves live buyers alone.
- **The review.** With the cover off and a test key, a test card opens a plan only for the team and `BILLING_TEST_ACCESS`. Anybody else sees "Test payment received, no plan was opened". Behind the cover nothing changes.
- **Return page.** Reads the first payment back itself and says paid, not paid, on its way, paid twice or test. It no longer refreshes forever after a failed payment, and it works where no webhook arrives.
- **Webhook.** A 200 for an id Mollie does not know (was a 500, retried ten times). No webhookUrl is sent where Mollie cannot reach the site.
- **One flow.** `/billing/pretend`, `FakeBilling` and the `StripeBilling` stub are removed. Without a key a paid plan goes to the contact form (`NoBilling`).
- **`SITE_NOINDEX`.** With the cover off, every response says noindex.

## Invoices in Mollie Invoicing (`BILLING_INVOICES`)

For every recorded payment: a sales invoice with status paid, tied to the Mollie payment (`paymentDetails.source = payment`), VAT inclusive so the total is the amount charged, the VAT note and period in the memo, and Peppol for BE/NL/DE businesses (`BILLING_PEPPOL`). Mollie's API cannot credit a paid invoice, so refunds and chargebacks are credited in Mollie's dashboard, and the bookkeeping mail names the invoice to credit. A buyer without a VAT number, or a refusal from Mollie, is kept on the row, said in the mail and retried nightly. In test mode, invoices go to `BILLING_TEST_INVOICE_EMAIL` (Mollie only mails verified users of the organisation there).

## The buyer is told

`PlanNotice`: a mail when the plan opens, when a renewal does not go through (with the date the plan ends unless paid, terms article 5), and when the plan is cancelled. A plan that was cancelled and is running out is bought again through checkout. Before, the change page called Mollie with an empty subscription id.

## Checked

- Against Mollie's test API from a local run, without a webhook: register, billing details (live VIES), checkout, Bancontact "paid". The plan opened, Mollie made the subscription and invoice I-GENTEL-2026-00002 (EUR 14.99 + 3.15 VAT = 18.14).
- Earlier probe: a refund leaves the invoice paid, and cancelling a paid invoice is refused (422).
- Suite: 707 of 708 (BuildStampTest needs a build stamp, which a worktree does not have). New: `MollieModesAndInvoicesTest`, a noindex test in `PreLaunchTest`.

## Deploy

- Migration `2026_11_25_090000_billing_mode_and_sales_invoices` is additive. Under the test key it marks existing billing ids and rows test.
- New env, all optional: `BILLING_TEST_ACCESS`, `BILLING_INVOICES`, `BILLING_PEPPOL`, `BILLING_TEST_INVOICE_EMAIL`, `BILLING_INVOICE_MAIL`, `SITE_NOINDEX`. Removed: `BILLING_DRIVER`, `STRIPE_*`.
- `docs/design/billing.md` describes test mode, the review, the invoice and the steps at the switch to live.
params.title: Mollie test mode made safe to show, an invoice in Mollie for every payment, and the buyer told
